title: uf/{head_id}/refs payload
description: UPSERT payload of uf/{head_id}/refs: the web pages the user keeps for a figure, as written, and never fetched by the service. Removing them is a DELETE with an empty payload. Serialized, at most 25,153 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

links.description: 1 to 10 distinct links, in the order the user keeps them.

url.description: An http or https URL of at most 2,000 characters, in RFC 3986 characters only (a non-ASCII or unsafe character is percent-encoded), so it can never carry a script, a space or markup. Private to the user: never logged.

label.description: 1 to 80 Unicode code points shown for the link; the host is shown when it is absent. Omit it rather than send an empty one.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
